spans.text: Saa adasamma Yiedie Ho Anodisɛm a wɔada no adie yi bɛyɛ susudua titire baako pɛ a, ɛwɔ hɔ ma nnipa ne amanaman nyinaa, na Ɔkɔntɛkorɔ anaa fekuo ahodoɔ nyinaa bɛma adi wɔn tirim dɛm, abɔ no dawuro akyerɛkyerɛ aseɛ yie pa ara, agye ato mu, adi so, na wɔde afa wɔn ankasa aman ne aman foforɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛɛ ahodɔ so ama ahyeta aman a wɔdɔm Amanaman Nkabom Kuo ne aman biara a ɛhyɛ n'ase mu.

entries.subject: no to

spans.text: Sɛ obiara kɔpue mmara anim wɔ baabiara a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye no to mu sɛ onipa.

entries.task_id: mmara|mu|deɛ
entries.description: Mmara mu deɛ

spans.text: Mmara mu deɛ, yɛnhwɛ obiara anim.

entries.subject: kwan so

spans.text: Sɛ obi bu mmara yi bi so tia ɔfoforɔ a, ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔde no fa mmara kwan so ne no di sɛdeɛ mmara seɛ.

entries.task_id: asɛm no|mu|koraa
entries.description: asɛm no mu koraa
entries.subject: asɛm no

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ asɛnnifoɔ no yɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm no mu koraa.

entries.task_id: a ɛwɔ|mu|a
entries.description: a ɛwɔ mu a
entries.subject: a ɛwɔ

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde so to obi so, nam so kye no, na wɔntumi mfeefee asɛm no mu, nhunuu nokorɛ a ɛwɔ mu a, yɛfa no sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no, gye sɛ wɔnam mmara kwan so, kɔ asɛm no mu, hunu sɛ ɔdi fɔ.

entries.task_id: de atete|ne|ho akyiri kwan
entries.description: de atete ne ho akyiri kwan
entries.subject: de atete

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde no kɔ asɛnniiɛ mpo koraa a, ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔhwehwɛ mmoa biara a ɔbɛtumi anya de atete ne ho akyiri kwan.

entries.task_id: so de|ne|ho hyehyɛ obi kɔkoamsɛm
entries.description: so de ne ho hyehyɛ obi kɔkoamsɛm
entries.subject: so de

spans.text: Ɛnsɛ sɛ obi fa ɛkwammɔne so de ne ho hyehyɛ obi kɔkoamsɛm, n'afisɛm anaa n'abusuasɛm mu.

entries.task_id: ntumi nsi|ne|yiedie ho kwan
entries.description: ntumi nsi ne yiedie ho kwan
entries.subject: ntumi nsi

spans.text: Mmmara bɔ onipa biara ho ban sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, biribiara ntumi nsi ne yiedie ho kwan.

entries.description: ɔman biara mu a ne man ka ho
entries.subject: ɔman biara

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtumi tu firi ɔman biara mu a ne man ka ho, sane ba ne man mu bio.

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtumi tu firi ɔman biara mu a ne man ka ho, sane ba ne man mu bio.

entries.task_id: foforɔ bi|mu|kɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ

entries.subject: foforɔ bi
entries.object: kɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ

spans.text: Sɛ obi manfoɔ reteetee no apɛ no atɔre n'ase a, ɛyɛ n'asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔdwane kɔ dwankɔbea bi wɔ ɔman foforɔ bi mu kɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ.

entries.task_id: nkabom kuo|nhyɛhyɛɛ|a
entries.description: Nkabom Kuo nhyɛhyɛɛ a
entries.subject: Nkabom Kuo

spans.text: Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛmfa amanyɔ ho anaa ɛntia Amanaman Nkabom Kuo nhyɛhyɛɛ a, ɛnyɛ onii no asɛdeɛ sɛ saa mmara yi bɔ ne ho ban firi saa bɔne no ho.

entries.task_id: yi bɔ|ne|ho ban firi saa bɔne no ho

entries.task_id: foforɔ bi|mu|kɔdane hɔni

entries.subject: foforɔ bi

spans.text: Ɛyɛ obiara asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔtumi kɔ oman foforɔ bi mu kɔdane hɔni.

entries.task_id: ntumi mmɔ|ne|tirim
entries.description: ntumi mmɔ ne tirim
entries.subject: ntumi mmɔ

spans.text: Obiara ntumi mmɔ ne tirim, mfa asisie kwan so nsakra obi nkyi.

entries.task_id: sɛ ɔsakra|ne|nkyi nso a
entries.description: sɛ ɔsakra ne nkyi nso a
entries.subject: sɛ ɔsakra

spans.text: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔsakra ne nkyi nso a, ɛyɛ n'asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔsakra berɛ a akwansideɛ biara nni mu.

entries.task_id: ɛyɛ mmarima|ne|mmaa a wɔanyinyini
entries.description: Ɛyɛ mmarima ne mmaa a wɔanyinyini
entries.subject: Ɛyɛ mmarima

spans.text: Ɛyɛ mmarima ne mmaa a wɔanyinyini, aso awadeɛ asɛdeɛ, sɛ wɔware wowo mma, berɛ a wɔn nipasuo, wɔn nkyi ne wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho.

entries.subject: Ɔtumi nso
entries.object: afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ

spans.text: Ɔtumi nso ne afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ.

entries.task_id: agyapadeɛ firi|ne|nsam kwa
entries.description: agyapadeɛ firi ne nsam kwa
entries.subject: agyapadeɛ firi

spans.text: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde ahupoo anaa nneyɛɛ a ɛnnam mmara kwan soɔ gye obi agyapadeɛ firi ne nsam kwa.

entries.task_id: sesa n'asɔre|ne|ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu
entries.description: sesa n'asɔre ne ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu
entries.subject: sesa n'asɔre
entries.object: ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu

spans.text: Saa tumi yi ma kwan ma obi tumi sesa n'asɔre ne ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu, na ɛmfa ho nso sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa bebree anaa ɔyɛ ɔkɔntɛkorɔ.

entries.task_id: sɛ wɔrebu|ne|man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a
entries.description: sɛ wɔrebu ne man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a
entries.subject: sɛ wɔrebu
entries.object: man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a

spans.text: Ɛyɛ onipa biara asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔrebu ne man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a, ɔka bie.

entries.task_id: tumi kɔ|mu|tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi
entries.description: tumi kɔ mu tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi
entries.subject: tumi kɔ
entries.object: tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi

spans.text: Onii no tumi kɔ mu tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi.

entries.task_id: biribiara a|ne|man mu aban bɛyɔ no
entries.description: biribiara a ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no
entries.subject: biribiara a

spans.text: Onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ biribiara a ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no, ɔnya ne so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

entries.task_id: ɔnya|ne|so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ
entries.description: ɔnya ne so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ
entries.subject: ɔnya

spans.text: Onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ biribiara a ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no, ɔnya ne so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

entries.task_id: obi nhunu|ne|yɔnko abatoɔ mu
entries.description: obi nhunu ne yɔnko abatoɔ mu
entries.subject: obi nhunu

spans.text: Wɔnam abatoɔ a dwinim biara nni mu, na obi nhunu ne yɔnko abatoɔ mu, na obiara a wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe biara to bie so na ɛdɛdi saa dwuma yi.

entries.task_id: ɔman no|ne|ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ
entries.description: ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ
entries.subject: ɔman no
entries.object: ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnam ɔman no ahoɔden anaa nkabom bi a saa ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ, di yie sɛdeɛ ɔman ko no sikasɛm, nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ.

entries.task_id: nnɔbaeɛ|ne|amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ
entries.description: nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ
entries.subject: nnɔbaeɛ
entries.object: amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnam ɔman no ahoɔden anaa nkabom bi a saa ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ, di yie sɛdeɛ ɔman ko no sikasɛm, nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ.

folded.id: a ɛwɔ|mu|a
folded.subject: a ɛwɔ

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde so to obi so, nam so kye no, na wɔntumi mfeefee asɛm no mu, nhunuu nokorɛ a ɛwɔ mu a, yɛfa no sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no, gye sɛ wɔnam mmara kwan so, kɔ asɛm no mu, hunu sɛ ɔdi fɔ.

folded.id: agyapadeɛ firi|ne|nsam kwa
folded.subject: agyapadeɛ firi

spans.text: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde ahupoo anaa nneyɛɛ a ɛnnam mmara kwan soɔ gye obi agyapadeɛ firi ne nsam kwa.

folded.id: anim nyam|ne|boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ
folded.subject: anim nyam
folded.object: boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

folded.id: ankasa aman|ne|aman foforɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛɛ ahodɔ so ama ahyeta aman a wɔdɔm amanaman nkabom kuo ne aman biara a ɛhyɛ n'ase mu
folded.subject: ankasa aman
folded.object: aman foforɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛɛ ahodɔ so ama ahyeta aman a wɔdɔm Amanaman Nkabom Kuo ne aman biara a ɛhyɛ n'ase mu

spans.text: Saa adasamma Yiedie Ho Anodisɛm a wɔada no adie yi bɛyɛ susudua titire baako pɛ a, ɛwɔ hɔ ma nnipa ne amanaman nyinaa, na Ɔkɔntɛkorɔ anaa fekuo ahodoɔ nyinaa bɛma adi wɔn tirim dɛm, abɔ no dawuro akyerɛkyerɛ aseɛ yie pa ara, agye ato mu, adi so, na wɔde afa wɔn ankasa aman ne aman foforɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛɛ ahodɔ so ama ahyeta aman a wɔdɔm Amanaman Nkabom Kuo ne aman biara a ɛhyɛ n'ase mu.

folded.id: anya n'ahofadie|ne|ahotɔ sɛdeɛ ɛfata no nti
folded.subject: anya n'ahofadie

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ aman hodoɔ a wɔfra Amanaman Kuo no mu ate wɔ ho ase ahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔne Amanaman Nkabom Kuo de anokorɔ bɛhwɛ ama obiara adi anodisɛm no ni, ama obiara anya n'ahofadie ne ahotɔ sɛdeɛ ɛfata no nti,

folded.id: ase asomdwoeɛ|ne|ahofadie mu a bɔne biara nka ne nipadua no
folded.subject: ase asomdwoeɛ
folded.object: ahofadie mu a bɔne biara nka ne nipadua no

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtena ase asomdwoeɛ ne ahofadie mu a bɔne biara nka ne nipadua no.

folded.id: asɛm no|mu|koraa
folded.subject: asɛm no

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ asɛnnifoɔ no yɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm no mu koraa.

folded.id: atɛntenenee|ne|asomdwoeɛ ase atim wɔ wiase yi mu nti
folded.subject: atɛntenenee
folded.object: asomdwoeɛ ase atim wɔ wiase yi mu nti

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ adasamma ahunu sɛ, yɛsusu onipa, bu no, di no ni a, ɛbɛma ahofadie, atɛntenenee ne asomdwoeɛ ase atim wɔ wiase yi mu nti,

folded.id: atia anitan|ne|ahupoo
folded.subject: atia anitan

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛba no sɛ obi de ahomteɛ bɛyɛ nneyɛɛ bi a ɛyɛ nneyɛɛ a ɛtwa toɔ koraa, a onii bɛtumi afa so de ako atia anitan ne ahupoo, berɛ a mmara bɔ adasamma yiedie anodisɛm ho ban nti,

folded.id: biribiara a|ne|man mu aban bɛyɔ no
folded.subject: biribiara a

spans.text: Onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ biribiara a ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no, ɔnya ne so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

folded.id: bu|ne|yɔnko
folded.subject: bu

spans.text: Ɛno nti, ɛsɛ sɛ obiara dɔ ne yɔnko, bu ne yɔnko, di ne yɔnko ni.

folded.id: de atete|ne|ho akyiri kwan
folded.subject: de atete

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde no kɔ asɛnniiɛ mpo koraa a, ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔhwehwɛ mmoa biara a ɔbɛtumi anya de atete ne ho akyiri kwan.

folded.id: di|ne|yɔnko ni
folded.subject: di

spans.text: Ɛno nti, ɛsɛ sɛ obiara dɔ ne yɔnko, bu ne yɔnko, di ne yɔnko ni.

folded.id: ɛka ho|ne|sɛ
folded.subject: ɛka ho

spans.text: Deɛ ɛka ho ne sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛto ɔman biara a obi firi mu ho, sɛ ɔman ko no di ne ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase.

folded.id: ɛna|ne|mma no nnyinasoɔ no yɛ abusuabɔ nnyinasoɔ mfitiaseɛ
folded.subject: ɛna
folded.object: mma no nnyinasoɔ no yɛ abusuabɔ nnyinasoɔ mfitiaseɛ

spans.text: Fidua a ɛyɛ agya, ɛna ne mma no nnyinasoɔ no yɛ abusuabɔ nnyinasoɔ mfitiaseɛ, na ɛyɛ fidua no asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔmanfoɔ bɔ wɔn ho ban.

folded.id: ɛyɛ mmarima|ne|mmaa a wɔanyinyini
folded.subject: Ɛyɛ mmarima

spans.text: Ɛyɛ mmarima ne mmaa a wɔanyinyini, aso awadeɛ asɛdeɛ, sɛ wɔware wowo mma, berɛ a wɔn nipasuo, wɔn nkyi ne wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho.

folded.id: foforɔ bi|mu|kɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ
folded.subject: foforɔ bi
folded.object: kɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ

spans.text: Sɛ obi manfoɔ reteetee no apɛ no atɔre n'ase a, ɛyɛ n'asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔdwane kɔ dwankɔbea bi wɔ ɔman foforɔ bi mu kɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ.

folded.id: foforɔ bi|mu|kɔdane hɔni
folded.subject: foforɔ bi

spans.text: Ɛyɛ obiara asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔtumi kɔ oman foforɔ bi mu kɔdane hɔni.

folded.id: ho anodisɛm|mu|asɛm yi wɔ hɔ ma obiara a nyiyimu biara nni mu
folded.subject: ho anodisɛm
folded.object: asɛm yi wɔ hɔ ma obiara a nyiyimu biara nni mu

spans.text: Yiedie ho anodisɛm mu asɛm yi wɔ hɔ ma obiara a nyiyimu biara nni mu.

folded.id: kuo no|mu|ate wɔ ho ase ahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔne amanaman nkabom kuo de anokorɔ bɛhwɛ ama obiara adi anodisɛm no ni
folded.subject: Kuo no
folded.object: ate wɔ ho ase ahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔne Amanaman Nkabom Kuo de anokorɔ bɛhwɛ ama obiara adi anodisɛm no ni

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ aman hodoɔ a wɔfra Amanaman Kuo no mu ate wɔ ho ase ahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔne Amanaman Nkabom Kuo de anokorɔ bɛhwɛ ama obiara adi anodisɛm no ni, ama obiara anya n'ahofadie ne ahotɔ sɛdeɛ ɛfata no nti,

folded.id: kwan so|ne|no di sɛdeɛ mmara seɛ
folded.subject: kwan so

spans.text: Sɛ obi bu mmara yi bi so tia ɔfoforɔ a, ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔde no fa mmara kwan so ne no di sɛdeɛ mmara seɛ.

folded.id: ma nnipa|ne|amanaman nyinaa
folded.subject: ma nnipa

spans.text: Saa adasamma Yiedie Ho Anodisɛm a wɔada no adie yi bɛyɛ susudua titire baako pɛ a, ɛwɔ hɔ ma nnipa ne amanaman nyinaa, na Ɔkɔntɛkorɔ anaa fekuo ahodoɔ nyinaa bɛma adi wɔn tirim dɛm, abɔ no dawuro akyerɛkyerɛ aseɛ yie pa ara, agye ato mu, adi so, na wɔde afa wɔn ankasa aman ne aman foforɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛɛ ahodɔ so ama ahyeta aman a wɔdɔm Amanaman Nkabom Kuo ne aman biara a ɛhyɛ n'ase mu.

folded.id: mmara|mu|deɛ
folded.subject: Mmara

spans.text: Mmara mu deɛ, yɛnhwɛ obiara anim.

folded.id: n'awosuom|ne|deɛ ɛkeka ho nsi obiara kwan wɔ saa nhyehyɛɛ yi ho
folded.subject: n'awosuom
folded.object: deɛ ɛkeka ho nsi obiara kwan wɔ saa nhyehyɛɛ yi ho

spans.text: Kasa a obi ka, asɔre a obi kɔ, amanyɔkuo ko a obi dɔm, deɛ obi fire, adwapadeɛ a ɔwɔ, n'awosuom ne deɛ ɛkeka ho nsi obiara kwan wɔ saa nhyehyɛɛ yi ho.

folded.id: nkabom kuo|mu|nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ amammuo nnyinasoɔ no mu
folded.subject: Nkabom Kuo
folded.object: nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

folded.id: nkabom kuo|nhyɛhyɛɛ|a
folded.subject: Nkabom Kuo

spans.text: Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛmfa amanyɔ ho anaa ɛntia Amanaman Nkabom Kuo nhyɛhyɛɛ a, ɛnyɛ onii no asɛdeɛ sɛ saa mmara yi bɔ ne ho ban firi saa bɔne no ho.

folded.id: nkoatɔ|ne|nkoatɔn yɛ dwadie bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtɔre aseɛ korakora
folded.subject: Nkoatɔ
folded.object: nkoatɔn yɛ dwadie bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtɔre aseɛ korakora

spans.text: Nkoatɔ ne nkoatɔn yɛ dwadie bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtɔre aseɛ korakora.

folded.id: nnɔbaeɛ|ne|amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ
folded.subject: nnɔbaeɛ
folded.object: amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnam ɔman no ahoɔden anaa nkabom bi a saa ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ, di yie sɛdeɛ ɔman ko no sikasɛm, nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ.

folded.id: no di|ne|ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase
folded.subject: no di
folded.object: ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase

spans.text: Deɛ ɛka ho ne sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛto ɔman biara a obi firi mu ho, sɛ ɔman ko no di ne ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase.

folded.id: no to|mu|sɛ onipa
folded.subject: no to

spans.text: Sɛ obiara kɔpue mmara anim wɔ baabiara a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye no to mu sɛ onipa.

folded.id: ntumi mmɔ|ne|tirim
folded.subject: ntumi mmɔ

spans.text: Obiara ntumi mmɔ ne tirim, mfa asisie kwan so nsakra obi nkyi.

folded.id: ntumi nsi|ne|yiedie ho kwan
folded.subject: ntumi nsi

spans.text: Mmmara bɔ onipa biara ho ban sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, biribiara ntumi nsi ne yiedie ho kwan.

folded.id: obi firi|mu|ho
folded.subject: obi firi

spans.text: Deɛ ɛka ho ne sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛto ɔman biara a obi firi mu ho, sɛ ɔman ko no di ne ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase.

folded.id: obi nhunu|ne|yɔnko abatoɔ mu
folded.subject: obi nhunu

spans.text: Wɔnam abatoɔ a dwinim biara nni mu, na obi nhunu ne yɔnko abatoɔ mu, na obiara a wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe biara to bie so na ɛdɛdi saa dwuma yi.

folded.id: obiara dɔ|ne|yɔnko
folded.subject: obiara dɔ

spans.text: Ɛno nti, ɛsɛ sɛ obiara dɔ ne yɔnko, bu ne yɔnko, di ne yɔnko ni.

folded.id: onipa yiedie|ne|n'ahofadie ho bɛma yɛn bɔhyɛ yi adi mu nti
folded.subject: onipa yiedie
folded.object: n'ahofadie ho bɛma yɛn bɔhyɛ yi adi mu nti

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ ntease pa a yɛbɛnya no wɔ anodisɛm a ɛfa onipa yiedie ne n'ahofadie ho bɛma yɛn bɔhyɛ yi adi mu nti,

folded.id: ɔman biara|mu|a ne man ka ho
folded.subject: ɔman biara

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtumi tu firi ɔman biara mu a ne man ka ho, sane ba ne man mu bio.

folded.id: ɔman no|ne|ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ
folded.subject: ɔman no
folded.object: ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnam ɔman no ahoɔden anaa nkabom bi a saa ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ, di yie sɛdeɛ ɔman ko no sikasɛm, nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ.

folded.id: ɔnya|ne|so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ
folded.subject: ɔnya

spans.text: Onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ biribiara a ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no, ɔnya ne so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

folded.id: ɔtumi nso|ne|afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ
folded.subject: Ɔtumi nso
folded.object: afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ

spans.text: Ɔtumi nso ne afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ.

folded.id: pae|mu|ka sɛ:
folded.subject: pae

spans.text: pae mu ka sɛ:

folded.id: sane ba|ne|man mu bio
folded.subject: sane ba

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtumi tu firi ɔman biara mu a ne man ka ho, sane ba ne man mu bio.

folded.id: sesa n'asɔre|ne|ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu
folded.subject: sesa n'asɔre
folded.object: ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu

spans.text: Saa tumi yi ma kwan ma obi tumi sesa n'asɔre ne ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu, na ɛmfa ho nso sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa bebree anaa ɔyɛ ɔkɔntɛkorɔ.

folded.id: sɛ atuateɛ|ne|obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ
folded.subject: sɛ atuateɛ
folded.object: obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ atuateɛ ne obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ, na abɛhwanyane nnipa ahonim de asetena foforɔ aba, ama nnipa ani aba wɔn ho so sɛ wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔka wɔn adwene a ehu biara nni mu, na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyɔ adwuma na ɛnhia wɔn, na ɛsiane sɛ wɔapae mu aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti,

folded.id: sɛ ɔsakra|ne|nkyi nso a
folded.subject: sɛ ɔsakra

spans.text: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔsakra ne nkyi nso a, ɛyɛ n'asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔsakra berɛ a akwansideɛ biara nni mu.

folded.id: sɛ wɔapae|mu|aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti
folded.subject: sɛ wɔapae
folded.object: aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ atuateɛ ne obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ, na abɛhwanyane nnipa ahonim de asetena foforɔ aba, ama nnipa ani aba wɔn ho so sɛ wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔka wɔn adwene a ehu biara nni mu, na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyɔ adwuma na ɛnhia wɔn, na ɛsiane sɛ wɔapae mu aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti,

folded.id: sɛ wɔrebu|ne|man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a
folded.subject: sɛ wɔrebu
folded.object: man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a

spans.text: Ɛyɛ onipa biara asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔrebu ne man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a, ɔka bie.

folded.id: so de|ne|ho hyehyɛ obi kɔkoamsɛm
folded.subject: so de

spans.text: Ɛnsɛ sɛ obi fa ɛkwammɔne so de ne ho hyehyɛ obi kɔkoamsɛm, n'afisɛm anaa n'abusuasɛm mu.

folded.id: tumi kɔ|mu|tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi
folded.subject: tumi kɔ
folded.object: tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi

spans.text: Onii no tumi kɔ mu tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi.

folded.id: wɔ ahogono|mu|nti
folded.subject: wɔ ahogono

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

folded.id: wɔbɛma asetena|mu|ayɛ yiɛ
folded.subject: wɔbɛma asetena

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

folded.id: wɔde adwene|ne|nyansa na abɔ obiara
folded.subject: wɔde adwene

spans.text: Na wɔde adwene ne nyansa na abɔ obiara.

folded.id: wɔn nkyi|ne|wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho
folded.subject: wɔn nkyi
folded.object: wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho

spans.text: Ɛyɛ mmarima ne mmaa a wɔanyinyini, aso awadeɛ asɛdeɛ, sɛ wɔware wowo mma, berɛ a wɔn nipasuo, wɔn nkyi ne wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho.

folded.id: yi bɔ|ne|ho ban firi saa bɔne no ho
folded.subject: yi bɔ
folded.object: ho ban firi saa bɔne no ho

spans.text: Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛmfa amanyɔ ho anaa ɛntia Amanaman Nkabom Kuo nhyɛhyɛɛ a, ɛnyɛ onii no asɛdeɛ sɛ saa mmara yi bɔ ne ho ban firi saa bɔne no ho.
